description: Reads this board runs by a trigger (a period, a change of the answer, an event) and sends to the one who added them, by itself, after one ADD.

commands.label: Add a watch
commands.description: Adds a watch of the sender, or replaces its watch with that id. The read follows the head: [key][dir READ][code | id u16 + op u16][args]; each answer goes back as an entry on the Watches stream: [owner][id][status][data].

fields.label: Watch
fields.description: The owner's id of the watch; adding an id the owner has replaces that watch

fields.label: Send to
fields.description: Where its entries go: 0 straight to the one who added it, else a connector of this board

fields.label: Period (ticks)
fields.description: Ticks of 10 ms. Every period: the read; on change: how often it reads; on event: the shortest gap

fields.label: Silence (ticks)
fields.description: On change: sent anyway after this many ticks, so silence never looks dead; 0 never

fields.label: Event source
fields.description: On event: device id, or 0xFFFF for any

fields.label: Event
fields.description: On event: the event id, 0xFFFF for any, or (contract << 8) | 0xFF for any of a contract

fields.label: Event channel
fields.description: On event: pin / channel, or 0xFF for any

commands.label: Remove a watch
commands.description: Removes the sender's watch with this id.

fields.label: Watch
fields.description: The sender's id of the watch

commands.label: List the watches
commands.description: Returns every watch of every owner.

returns.label: Number of watches
returns.description: Then per watch: its head (12 B as ADD takes it), its owner u8 and the length of its read u8.
